senses.gloss:
mf. (-णिः-णिः or-णी)
1 A line, a row, a range.
2 A company of artisans following the same business.
3 A corporation, a company of traders or those dealing in the same articles.
4 A bucket, a baling vessel.
E.
श्रि to serve, नि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
The name of one of the kings of Magadhā, contemporary with and patron of ŚĀKYASIṂHA.
f. (-का)
A tent.
E.
श्रेणि a line, &c., कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made or become a heap.
2 Arranged, set in rows.
E.
श्रेणि a range, भूत become, च्चि augment.

f. (-धी)
1 A set or succession of substances.
2 (In arithmetic,) Progression.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Best, excellent, most excellent.
ind.
Well, most excellent.
n. (-यः)
1 Virtue, moral merit.
2 Final happiness.
3 Good fortune, auspiciousness, prosperity.
m. (-प्रान्)
The 11th Jina or Jaina pontiff.
f. (-यसी)
1 A plant resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)
2 A shrub, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
3 Yellow myrobalan.
E.
श्र substituted for प्रशस्त good, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Conferring, or the means of, future felicity.
2 Propitious.
3 Making better or superior.
E.
श्रेयस्, and कर who or what does.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Desiring final felicity, &c.
E.
श्रेयस्, and काम desire.

n. (-स्त्वं)
1 Superiority, betterness.
2 Final felicity, &c.
E.
श्रेयस्, and त्व aff.

m. (-शः)
The eleventh Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era; also श्रेयांस.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Desirous of good, ambitious.
E.
श्रेयस्, and अर्थिन् who asks.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Best, excellent, most excellent, pre-eminent.
2 Oldest, senior.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1 KUVERA.
2 A king.
3 A Brahman.
n. (-ष्ठं)
Cow's milk.
E.
श्र for प्रशस्त best, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.

n. (-ष्ठं)
The main pillar of a house.
E.
श्रेष्ठ best, and काष्ठ timber.

f. (-ता)
Superiority, betterness, excellence.
E.
श्रेष्ठ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, श्रेष्ठत्वं.

m. (-मः)
The householder.
E.
श्रेष्ठ best, आश्रम order or state; the householder being considered the best of the four orders, as he supports the other three.

mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि)
Best, chief.
m. (-ष्ठी)
1 An artist eminent by birth.
2 The head or chief of a body of persons following the same trade or occupation, a president, a foreman.
E.
श्रेष्ठ excellence, इनि aff.

(ऋ) स्रेकृ r. 1st cl. (स्रेकते)
To go, to move.
